# table 1 
```{r}
library(tableone)
library(crosstable)
#merge meta and a diversity table
physeq_alpha_div <- read.csv('../Output/physeq_alpha_div.csv')
physeq_alpha_div <- physeq_alpha_div[, 1:(which(names(physeq_alpha_div) == "Patient_id") - 1)]
# merge meta and a diversity
physeq_alpha_div <- merge(physeq_alpha_div, meta, by = 'Sample_id')


# add Tumor stage IV info
physeq_alpha_div <- as.data.frame(physeq_alpha_div)
names(physeq_alpha_div) <- make.unique(names(physeq_alpha_div))
physeq_alpha_div <- physeq_alpha_div %>% 
  mutate(Tumor_stage_IV = "Y")

# export
write.csv(physeq_alpha_div, '../Output/physeq_alpha_div.csv')

vars_table1 <- c(
  "age_MBC_dx",                 
  "race",
  "Menopausal_status",
  "BMI_cat",
  "Family.history.of.BC",     
  "Smoking",
  "Alcohol",
  "Tumor_stage_IV",
  "ER",
  "TNBC",
  "Pre.enrollment_surgery",
  "Pre.enrollment_Chemotherapy",
  "Pre.enrollment_Radiation",
  "Pre.enrollment_Hormonal.Therapy",
  "Pre.enrollment_Targeted.Therapy",
  "survival_months",           
  "vital",
  "CTC_count_cat",              
  "diversity_shannon",
  "chao1"
)
# crosstable
tab1 <- crosstable(
  data = physeq_alpha_div,
  cols = all_of(vars_table1),
  by = NULL,
  test = FALSE      
)

ft <- as_flextable(tab1)
ft

flextable::save_as_docx(ft, path = "../Output/Table1_output.docx")

#tableone
factor_vars <- c(
  "race","Menopausal_status","BMI_cat",
  "Family.history.of.BC","Smoking","Alcohol",
  "Tumor_stage_IV","ER","TNBC",
  "Pre.enrollment_surgery","Pre.enrollment_Chemotherapy",
  "Pre.enrollment_Radiation","Pre.enrollment_Hormonal.Therapy",
  "Pre.enrollment_Targeted.Therapy",
  "vital","CTC_count_cat"
)

physeq_alpha_div[factor_vars] <- lapply(physeq_alpha_div[factor_vars], factor)
tab1.2 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = vars_table1,
  data = physeq_alpha_div,
  factorVars = factor_vars,
  includeNA = TRUE
)
print(tab1.2, showAllLevels = TRUE, quote = TRUE, noSpaces = TRUE)

tab1_df <- as.data.frame(
  print(tab1.2, showAllLevels = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)
) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable")

# change flextable
library(flextable)
ft <- flextable(tab1_df)
ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)  
ft <- autofit(ft)
ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")

save_as_docx(
  "Table 1" = ft,
  path = "../Output/Table1_three_line.docx"
)
```
